sequential_dependency.intermediate: The tableau bounding box, background color, and the input-derived color-to-quarter-turn-count map.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the radius-two-connected square tableau and count detached cue cells for each tableau color modulo four.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Rotate each color layer independently by its own count in the episode direction, then composite the transformed layers.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: A cell destination in B is selected by the count attached to that cell color; no layer rotation can be chosen until A has found the tableau and counted its detached cues.

parametric_work.summary: The byte-identical canonical program rotates each tableau colour clockwise by its detached cue count; the alternative reverses only the turn direction. Two demonstrations distinguish the settings on matched inputs.

remaining_failures: Owner registration, exact-source review, unchanged-source native qualification, and acceptance remain pending.
target.summary: Authored the missing general cue-count layer-rotation rule and a clockwise/counterclockwise native family with constructive 2–6 demonstration episodes, four private queries, official-label execution, bounded rival review, causal replay, and privacy-audited exports.
